tool_args.rationale: All five observations are at H ≤ 0.48, while confirmation targets H = 20.3. The long-horizon probe directly tests whether slow adaptation offsets or reverses the early positive response before fitting the sink-coupled law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, slow adaptation mainly identifies the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. A good pilot fit can therefore give an unreliable forecast at H = 20.3.
Finer short-window measurements do not directly resolve whether slow adaptation saturates or reverses the response near the forecast horizon.
It omits the observed sink-gradient dependence.
